notes: WorldSlot's stored properties beyond id/name/createdAt all carry `= nil` defaults (lastPlayedAt line 31, thumbnailFileName line 32, worldLevelName line 38, worldSeed line 44), so a slot.json written before those fields existed -- or one copied in from a legacy/imported source -- decodes cleanly rather than failing. zipSizeBytes is excluded from CodingKeys entirely (line 59, comment at line 46-47) and is instead populated by loadSlots as a cheap stat of world.zip on disk (lines 313-318); with no zip file present it stays nil after load, same as a freshly-decoded slot before that stat runs.
